issues.message: Generate only product lines with unlocked producers/compatible shelves; no impossible locked demand. Start with a single fish order, then naturally allow 2 different products and/or 2 units after expansion; collect all lines before entering checkout. Show gathered versus outstanding items; price earned only after all items, queue-head service and packing.

Original smokehouse consumes fresh fish from its configured input shelf, subject to unlock and output capacity. With input absent the progress remains stopped; replenishing the connected shelf resumes processing. Player automatically picks up processed smoked fish and deposits it at the matching new shelf; no free output or negative inventories.

Original hire stations let the player fund a visible stock runner and cashier through stationary installments. Stock runner physically travels between net and matching fish shelf with bounded cargo; cashier remains at checkout and services the same queue-head packing/cash branch. Cashier money still enters the counter pile; the player must collect it. No instant revenue or teleporting replenishment.

An original beach seagull reaches a stocked compatible shelf after the shop is expanded; it alerts that shelf and periodically removes at most one available item. Normal player approach scares it off and stops losses; refill recovers customer supply. The recovery is an original target-game rule, not a claim about the reference. Keep approved 8-second stockout patience starting only at shelf arrival; show shrinking local patience and product shortage, explicit shortage departure and replenish recovery.

Preserve base fish operation and first kelp expansion settlement with continue locally/restart actions. Continue locally preserves completed unlocks. After expansion a clearly separate next-market marker becomes reachable. Only stationary normal input inside the marker opens the market-selection panel. Provide two original real markets, Coral Bay and Moon-Tide Pier, with distinct station arrangement, atmosphere, demand/processing bottleneck and authored construction target. Choosing a valid market activates that world and a reachable new core loop/goal/settlement; invalid or locked choice cannot mutate state. No post-choice return to unchanged home disguised as a new market.

Default entrypoint wires every new branch into normal operating tick/render/save/load; compatibility-only old fields must be labeled and never select the old minimum journey. Protect keyboard/pointer release and blur; no stuck motion. Reduced motion preserves visible critical signals without flight/bounce dependence. Critical guidance uses icons/rings/station progress/route position; helper copy reinforces only. Compact mobile overlay controls >=44 CSS px and fully reachable.
